# Repository infrastructure port

## Evidence and scope

Source: `octopot/indexit` at `49738e3`, the Codex session `01a0b496-cc8f-7290-91b3-80e40f2dc620`, and the recent Claude sessions, especially `2320de26-0ea9-49f6-8457-6b99fdb8b61b`, `089b8040-e94c-4091-8f0c-b1031e529cac`, and the September release/Pages follow-ups. The source worktree was clean when inspected. Maintainer started at `567817f` with unrelated issue/roadmap edits already present; these were preserved.

This is an adaptation of the Actions audit and the later operational fixes. It includes the Makefile, activation environment, lint/release configuration, shared Actions helpers, and one fixture-test adjustment needed to make the requested workflows executable. It does not change application behavior or publish a release. No commits, tags, pushes, workflow dispatches, remote settings changes, or cleanup operations were made.

## Adaptation decisions

| Area | Source direction | Maintainer adaptation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Actions | `2f8b108`, `23b0974`, `6dc6bf5`: current action contracts, permissions, runner pin | Ubuntu 24.04, concrete tags, OIDC coverage, real Go module filters, optional composite Slack notification |
| Go | `0056b78`: current Go; `25e2cb7`: ignore build/site directories | Application minimum stays 1.26; CI tests 1.26.x and 1.x. Tools need 1.27.1. Only bin/dist/docs excluded from package patterns |
| Tools | `a632000`, `e8b1c26`: upstream tools and native tool directive | Keep all seven original tools, add lint/release/CUE/vulnerability tools, remove tools.go, install/list/update via tool pattern |
| Dependency checks | `9f58c54`, `a327e10`: separate app/tools gates and tidy before release | Application scan in CI/CD; honest tool scan in tools.yml only; generation and tidy checked for drift |
| Downloads | `8d0f89f`: public proxy first | Fix both Makefile and bin/activate; preserve maintainer's GOPRIVATE setting |
| Release | `55f756c`, `4c1b62b`: GoReleaser v2, Cask, tag/note/secrets checks | Preserve maintainer binary, targets, archive names, and tap; no fictitious stable release or tag; no replacement of existing hooks |
| Pages | `4c00721`, `0601c14`: Nextra 4 static export and domain checks | Build maintainer's existing contribution guide/changelog, not indexit's product pages. Default /maintainer/ URL; custom domain supported. PR previews do not need Pages configured |
| Doctor | `7bdf8e3`: vanity-import checks and configuration drift | Check all four maintainer vanity imports, actual disabled-workflow state, Pages, and tap credential availability |
| Cache/history cleanup | `8c80e3f`, `f0b4f39`: gh cache and truthful dry run | Preserve zero retention, allow All, add permissions. Warmup follows successful cache cleanup |
| Release cache | `199df47`: expensive gotd cross-build optimization | Not imported: maintainer's four-target snapshot takes seconds locally, without gotd memory pressure. CD/app warmup share go.sum keys; tool checks/tools warmup share tools/go.sum keys |
| Daily healthcheck | Maintainer-specific live GitHub fixtures | Retain it. Fix hard-coded 2025 expectation by passing the live capture year; committed fixture tests still expect 2025 |
| Stale issue automation | Already present in indexit's original scaffold | Not introduced: maintainer had no equivalent automatic issue-closing policy |

The docs dependency lock came from indexit. Its npm audit findings were resolved within compatible dependency ranges (`speech-rule-engine`/XML parsing dependencies); final npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities. `.npmrc` retains the public registry. Search remains disabled as in indexit because static search indexing is not configured.

## Action versions

All of these tags were resolved through GitHub's ref API during verification. They are explicit versions, not claims that every upstream action was independently re-audited from its first release.

| Action | Version |
| --- | --- |
| `Mattraks/delete-workflow-runs` | `v2.1.0` |
| `actions/checkout` | `v7.0.1` |
| `actions/configure-pages` | `v6.0.0` |
| `actions/deploy-pages` | `v5.0.1` |
| `actions/download-artifact` | `v8.0.1` |
| `actions/setup-go` | `v7.0.0` |
| `actions/setup-node` | `v7.0.0` |
| `actions/upload-artifact` | `v7.0.1` |
| `actions/upload-pages-artifact` | `v5.0.0` |
| `codecov/codecov-action` | `v7.1.1` |
| `golangci/golangci-lint-action` | `v9.3.0` |
| `goreleaser/goreleaser-action` | `v7.2.3` |

GoReleaser is pinned to 2.18.2 in the tool module and action input. Golangci-lint is pinned to 2.14.0 in both places and its v2 configuration validates. The mock generator resolves to 1.7.0-rc.1 under the combined tool module's minimum-version selection; generating the existing mocks produces no changes. The root module keeps its existing mock runtime and dependencies.

The tool scan intentionally remains a real failing gate, consistent with indexit's latest policy:

- [GO-2026-6225](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6225): `docker-credential-acr-env`, pulled through GoReleaser; no fixed version reported.
- [GO-2026-5932](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5932): unmaintained `golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp`; no fixed version reported.

These findings are not suppressed or moved into the application's release gate. Tools validation will report them after activation. Replacing the affected upstream functionality is separate from this infrastructure port.

## GitHub rollout remains after the user's commit

The files are prepared and locally verified, but the remote repository still runs the old committed definitions. Pages, Codecov OIDC onboarding, and tap-secret access cannot be proven by a local build. No live deployment, release publication, Slack message, cache deletion, or run deletion was tested.

Follow [workflow setup](../workflows/README.md#set-up-github) after committing and pushing. It lists the seven workflows to enable, Pages/environment configuration, required tap permissions, initial dispatches, and the destructive cleanup behavior. Run doctor after the first Pages deployment. Actual GitHub-hosted checks remain the final deployment evidence.
